# PDF Ingestion

- Validate MIME type and file size before extraction.
- Enforce Free vs Pro upload limits server-side.
- Store document metadata and extracted text safely.
- Clean up temporary files after failures.
- Enforce ownership on every document operation.
- Test invalid file type, oversized file, quota exceeded, and cross-user access.
